product.description: Workstream™ by Monoprice™Bluetooth® 5.0 + USB Transmitter Wireless Web Meeting HeadsetWireless web conferencing headset with built‑in or detachable boom micEnhance your online web meetings and free up your office workspace with a wireless headset specially designed for online web conferencing. The Workstream™ by Monoprice™ Bluetooth Wireless Web Meeting Headset boasts a unique design feature, offering a built‑in mic, as well as an optional detachable boom mic that is fine tuned to pick up more of your voice and less ambient noise.
